notes.title: Master of the Forbidden Sea: Stormy Love | Bundle
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35196094/5800a85ceb7a82c186b2f6f4c96e79cb6516b349.png
Dear Gamers,

We've been polishing and enhancing MotFS version 1.1.4 and it's more fun than ever.

After intense rounds of play-testing and development of a long list of new features, we are ready to reintroduce the Forbidden Sea to Steam sea dogs and hope you will enjoy it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1100070/Master_of_the_Forbidden_Sea/
 New Features | 1.1.4 
 Storms & Wind added to Oversea Map
 Compass of Destiny: Reveals pathway to next Treasure Chest
 Find Love with the Bar Wench at Cape Hope
 Procedural Dance Generator: If the Bar Wench is so inclined
 Crashing into rocks now slightly more forgiving
 Healing Power Up: After each dance 
 Boosts Randomization of procedural Dive Experiences
 Better Encounter chances of rare oversea Monsters
 More Randomized Fish Schooling
 Better Chest Finding Randomization
 New Shopkeeper Graphics
 More hover-over help text
 New Introduction Narration
 Better chance for random undersea events
 Entering the Vortex to the Forbidden Sea before you are skilled enough now results in Doom
 Enhanced Portal from the Undersea
 Treasure Chests slightly easier to interact with from the sides
 Treasure Chest opening speed increased
 Finally stops shop keeper from "accepting" artifacts he cannot afford
 Adds XP for defeating Undersea Monsters
 Minor Fixes & Animation Updates
How to Play: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1807071111
For those seeking even more adventure, MotFB will soon be bundled and discounted with our recently updated sci-fi action rogue-like which features bewildering self-replicating monsters from far, far, away:

Bewildering Beasts Bundle  
...Coming soon...

We hope you master the forbidden sea, fall in love, and leave us an excellent Steam review.

Thank you very much,
AdventRPG
GM-X

Please report any problems or bugs in Steam Discussions. We fix most reported bugs within 2-buisness days.

notes.title: Hotfixes & Updates: 1.1.X
notes.content:
We been enhancing the game and polishing the experience as we receive play testing feedback. Check this log for the many small changes making the game more fun:

 Should fix all issues with love and dancing caused by visiting town repeatedly 
 Fixes issues with Heart Power-Up spawning without dancing
 Fixes a bug with Sinister Cyclones crossing to the Oversea
 Greatly boosts randomization of diving elements
 Fixes incorrect hover-over text for Giant Pearl
 Restricts artifacts from being given to the Shop Keeper for free
 Portal from the Undersea now has a slight delay before it can be used to return to the Oversea
 More Randomized Encounters
 Better Chest Finding Randomization
 More Randomized fish schooling
 Treasure Chests slightly easier to interact with from the sides
 Entering the Vortex to the Forbidden Sea before you are skilled enough now results in doom
 Added visible damage to lowbie captains entering the vortex
 Added a glowing highlight to make Cape Hope more noticeable
 Should fix undersea islands that failed to transition after entering portal 
 Bar Wench relationship status no longer resets after being defeated in sword fights
 Adds XP for winning Undersea Fights
 Finally stops shop keeper from "accepting" artifacts he cannot afford
 Treasure Chest opening speed increased
 Better chance for random undersea events
 Fixes heart progress stall at level 11
 Late random encounters now possible on certain dives 
 Fixes Kraken attack animation triggering
Please report any bugs or great suggestions in Steam Discussions.

notes.title: Master of the Forbidden Sea: Stormy Love | 1.1.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35196094/1b300441ad8df9557837583d347fc6eda05314a6.png
Hello Pirates & Treasure Hunters!

After a long pause in development, Master of the Forbidden Sea is back with epic new features:

 New Features | 1.1.4 
 Storms & Wind added to Oversea Map
 Compass of Destiny: now reveals a path to next Treasure Chest
 Find Love with the Bar Wench at Cape Hope
 Procedural Dance Generator: If the Bar Wench is so inclined
 Crashing into rocks now slightly more forgiving
 Healing Power Up: After each dance 
 Boosts randomization of procedural dive experiences
 Better Encounter chances of stranger monsters
 Adds XP for defeating Undersea Monsters
 New Shopkeeper Graphics
 More hover-over help text
 New Introduction Narration
 Better chance for random undersea events
 Late random encounters now possible on certain dives 
 Minor Fixes & Animation Updates
We still have big plans for MotFS, but the 1.1 update adds more direction and playability to the core game mechanics. If you encounter any problems, or have any great suggestions please contact us on Steam Discussions. 

AdventRPG
GM-X

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1100070/Master_of_the_Forbidden_Sea/
